It features two circular spool windows with visible internal hubs, a central rectangular window showing the dark magnetic tape, and a label area at the top with handwritten-style text that appears gibberish or stylized. The bottom edge shows molded structural details like teeth/slots for the player mechanism. The image has a grainy, noisy texture reminiscent of old film or high-ISO digital noise.
